menu_options.discover: Search the sauna on the network
menu_options.wifi: Connect a sauna to Wi-Fi (first setup or new network/password)

wifi.title: Connect the sauna to Wi-Fi
wifi.description:
1. On the panel: press CHANGE twice, then hold on/off for 5 s until the REMOTE led blinks (hammam/Logica: hold on/off 5 s until the House icon blinks).
2. Enter the 2.4 GHz Wi-Fi network and its password.
3. Home Assistant sends the data for 45 s (EspTouch) and, without an answer, 45 s more (SmartLink). It works best if the router forwards multicast to Wi-Fi.

data_description.bssid: MAC of the 2.4 GHz radio of the access point nearest to the sauna, e.g. AA:BB:CC:DD:EE:FF. Empty = 00:00:00:00:00:00.

progress.provisioning: Sending the Wi-Fi network to the sauna (up to 90 seconds)...

error.cannot_connect: Cannot connect to the sauna. Check IP and port.
error.no_devices: No sauna found on the network: enter the IP address.
error.no_answer: The sauna did not answer. Check that the REMOTE led blinks, that the network is 2.4 GHz and the password; try again.

abort.already_configured: This sauna is already configured (address updated).

discover.name: Search saunas
discover.description: Search Effe ECC modules on the network (UDP 48899) and return IP, MAC, serial and firmware.

hosts.name: Addresses to query
hosts.description: IPs to query directly too, if the router blocks broadcasts.

wifi_setup.name: Connect the sauna to Wi-Fi
wifi_setup.description: Send network and password to the Wi-Fi module in configuration mode (REMOTE led blinking). For the first setup or to change network or password.

sync_time.name: Sync clock
sync_time.description: Set the Home Assistant time on the sauna.
